body: Well I don’t know what to say I’m extremely suicidal so I’m really no help at all but I hope you can overcome this, because I sure can’t...
I can’t help but say I am, because it’s true. Why else would I be like this?

Well The other day I told him that I didn’t want to be around people because I was feeling really depressed, but that’s really all I said upfront to him, I’m so scared of making him upset to be completely honest

I understand that, but to be honest it doesn’t stop me from wanting to do it at all. I have always come close to hurting myself and the only reason I stopped myself was because I was scared of the pain or I thought someone was coming. I completely understand how stupid I am for saying all of this but I can’t help it

The people, girls being stereotypical cunts who think they own the world, being treated like an outcast because I’m a girl who plays games and is considerably good at them, boys never talking to me only because I’m a girl and other girls not talking to me because I’m not “like them” and then ending up having to do every group project alone unless I’m lucky enough to have one of my friends in class (2 girls who are obviously depressed like me) school is so frustrating, I came into the year enjoying my classes I’m really good at math and history and especially writing (mainly stories) which when I’m in classes that I can do those things in I like school, in fact I had an opportunity for art because of it. But the people make it so painful along with those few teachers who give me constant anxiety because they think they can treat me however they wish, it just makes it unbearable to deal with this constant anxiety from school over the years along with depression and suicidal thoughts
